charts.title: TOI-286 c: orbits around TOI-286
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-286's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-286 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Hobson et al. 2024 (2024A&A...688A.216H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HOBSON_ET_AL_2024): P 39.361826 d

charts.title: TOI-286 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-286 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (96, 97, 98) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 150030205, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 10 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 20-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 8 min late; 20-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 3 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
